== Summary ==
Uncaptioned photograph of a man with a moustache holding a sheet of image thumbnails at a Decipher workstation, 1996. It sits in the article's "CD search" and "Scanning" sections, which describe [[Dan Burns]]'s work. Candidate identification only: the photo has no caption naming him. Photo: InQuest.

== Source ==
* Rick Swan, "Star Tours: How a ''Star Wars'' card is made", ''[[InQuest]]'' 17 (September 1996), pp. 54–60; photograph on p. 56. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-issue-17-images_202008/page/n57/mode/1up Internet Archive] (leaf n57). The Internet Archive item is itself the preserved copy.
* Cropped from the page scan to the man only, leaving out the neighbouring inset photo and text (box 57,1189 to 322,1529 of the 1473×2048 leaf).
* Identification: a candidate for Dan Burns, from its place in the sections about him; not confirmed. See [[Talk:Dan Burns]].

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced photograph from a page of a magazine article about how Decipher made ''Star Wars'' CCG cards, used only to help identify Dan Burns on his article on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the magazine or harm its market.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-2/25/Dan_Burns_candidate_InQuest_17_p56_%281996%29.jpg Internet Archive item].
